card.name: Refer to / please consult instructions
card.fires_on: The word 'to' after 'Refer' (or 'refer'/'consult'/'contact' after 'Please') when the text sends the reader to another section, document, or person. Mostly in label dosing and interaction sections, also in web disclaimers.

modes.label: Refer to another label section
modes.description: 'Refer to' pointing to other prescribing information or a named section.
modes.example: Refer<< to>> the prescribing information for EDURANT (

modes.label: Please consult or contact
modes.description: 'Please' followed by refer, consult or contact in web disclaimers and contact lines.
modes.example: Please<< consult>> your physician with any questions or concerns you

card.writes: Promotes words like consult and 'learn more / contact us', which fit a referral to further information.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the text tells the reader to go look elsewhere or ask someone.
